source.text:
RO: În episodul 1 din “Berlin în Farfurie” îl avem invitat pe Tobias Beck, unul dintre cei mai talentați bucătari germani din noua generație, executive chef la @claerchens_ballhaus şi fondator al conceptului @ember_berlin. 

De fiecare dată când ajungem în Berlin avem FOMO şi nu ştim ce locuri să încercăm mai repede, aşa că i-am invitat pe unii dintre cei mai relevanți oameni din industrie să ne povestească despre locurile lor preferate. Fiți pe fază, urmează şi alte episoade! 😁

EN: In episode 1 of “Berlin on a Plate” we’re joined by Tobias Beck, one of the most talented German chefs of the new generation, executive chef at @claerchens_ballhaus and founder of the @ember_berlin concept. 

Every time we’re in Berlin, we get serious FOMO and never know which places to try first, so we invited some of the most relevant people in the industry to tell us about their favorite spots.

Stay tuned, more episodes are coming! 😁

reference.notes: The transcript garbles most names; spellings are kept as transcribed (e.g. Back and Break, Gutes Haus Soehne, Speicher Bowenhaus). Several picks were left out because no venue name is recoverable: the unnamed Charlottenburg restaurant with the meat aspic, the Persian döner said as "tacos", and "curry versus curry powder". Sophie, Papaya, Gotcha and Special Sauce were read as venue names from context.

match.note: The @ember_berlin concept is most plausibly the only Ember venue listed, though it is categorised as a caterer.
Likely the Mitte cocktail bar Buck and Breck, which is not among the candidates; Break Lounge Bar is in Treptow.
'Koenigsberg' reads as a transcript slip for Kreuzberg; the roastery in the Adalbertstraße backyard is the only Kreuzberg branch.
A pizza bakery run by Max; the only 'Common' candidate is a Neukölln café, which is not clearly the same venue.
The spoken 'Sophie' for the best bakery matches SOFI, a bakery.
'Victoria Park' does not clearly identify either branch.
The Kreuzberg spot with pig ears and paella is the tapas bar Gotxa, not the Vietnamese Gotcha in Friedrichshain.
